claims: Banksy has maintained an anonymous identity since the 1990s.
A 2026 Reuters report identifies Banksy as Robin Gunningham.
Robin Gunningham is a former Bristol artist.
Robin Gunningham is linked to Banksy through geographic profiling.
Robin Gunningham is linked to Banksy through photo evidence.
Robin Gunningham is linked to Banksy through a 2000 arrest record.
There are suggestions that Robin Gunningham may have used the alias David Jones.
Gunningham's movements match the appearance of Banksy’s artwork.
A connection between Gunningham and Banksy was suggested as far back as 2008 according to reports in Wikipedia and Artsper Magazine.
A 2016 study reinforced a connection between Gunningham and Banksy according to reports in Wikipedia and Artsper Magazine.
A 2026 Reuters investigation indicated Gunningham may have changed his name to David Jones.
Some have speculated that Robert Del Naja of the band Massive Attack could be Banksy.
Mark Stephens has not confirmed or denied the identification.
Mark Stephens previously said that unveiling the identity would put him in danger as reported by The Hollywood Reporter and E! News.
